4-Day Jordan Tour: Petra, Madaba & Dead Sea
summary:
The 4-Day Amman & Petra Tour keeps the route focused on central and southern Jordan, covering several key sites without extending into Wadi Rum or Aqaba. Begin in Amman before traveling to Madaba and Mount Nebo, two important stops connected with the region’s biblical history. Time at the Dead Sea provides a break between cultural visits before continuing south to Petra, where the Nabataean city becomes the main archaeological focus of the journey.
The compact route is handled by private transportation and can operate throughout the year. Selected 4-star hotels with breakfast, English-speaking local guides, transfers, entrance fees and scheduled sightseeing are included during the four-day program.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Amman
itinerary.text:
Arrival at Queen Alia International Airport. Meet and transfer to your hotel in Amman.
Hotel check-in after 14:00. The remainder of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Amman.

itinerary.title: Amman Hotel – Madaba – Mt. Nebo – Dead Sea – Petra Hotel
itinerary.text: Visit Madaba and see the famous 6th-century mosaic map at the Saint George Church. Continue to Mount Nebo, where Prophet Moses viewed the Promised Land. Visit the old monastery and enjoy panoramic views over the Jordan Valley, the Dead Sea, and the Holy Land. Later, drive to the Dead Sea and enjoy the unique experience of floating in its salty waters before continuing to Petra. Overnight in Petra.

itinerary.title: Petra Visit Then Back to Amman Hotel
itinerary.text: Explore Petra, Jordan’s famous red-rose city and ancient Nabataean capital. Walk through the Siq to reach the impressive Al-Khazneh (Treasury). Continue to the Street of Facades, Royal Tombs, and Pharaoh’s Castle while discovering Petra’s ancient temples, tombs, and remarkable rock-cut monuments. Later, drive back to Amman. Overnight in Amman.

faqs.q: What destinations are included in the 4-Day Jordan Tour?
faqs.a: The 4-Day Jordan Tour covers Amman and Petra, Jordan's two most popular destinations. This private itinerary combines the vibrant capital city of Amman with the spectacular UNESCO World Heritage Site of Petra, offering an excellent introduction to Jordan's history, culture, and archaeology. The tour runs for 3 nights and 4 days.

faqs.q: How much does the 4-Day Jordan Tour cost?
faqs.a: The tour starts from €795 per person for the 2026 season. The price includes accommodation, private land transportation, an English-speaking driver, entrance fees according to the itinerary, selected meals, and airport and hotel transfers. Final pricing may vary depending on travel dates and hotel category.

faqs.q: Is transportation included throughout the tour?
faqs.a: Yes, private land transportation is included throughout the itinerary. You will travel comfortably in a private vehicle with an English-speaking driver, ensuring a flexible and convenient travel experience.

faqs.q: What kind of accommodation does the tour provide?
faqs.a: The package includes accommodation in carefully selected hotels with daily breakfast. Hotels are chosen for their comfort, quality service, and convenient locations in Amman and near Petra.

faqs.q: Is a guide included in the tour?
faqs.a: This package includes an English-speaking driver rather than a full-time tour guide. Local guides can be arranged at Petra upon request. Your driver will assist with transportation, logistics, and general travel information throughout your journey.

faqs.q: Is this tour suitable for first-time visitors to Jordan?
faqs.a: Yes, this tour is ideal for first-time visitors with limited time. It focuses on Jordan's most famous attraction, Petra, while also providing an opportunity to explore the highlights of Amman.

faqs.q: How fit do I need to be for the tour?
faqs.a: The physical difficulty is moderate. Travelers should be comfortable walking through archaeological sites and uneven terrain. Petra involves several kilometers of walking, including the famous Siq pathway leading to the Treasury.

faqs.q: What are the highlights of Amman and Petra?
faqs.a: Amman offers a fascinating blend of ancient and modern attractions, including the Citadel, Roman Theater, and vibrant local markets. Petra is Jordan's most iconic UNESCO World Heritage Site, famous for the Treasury, Monastery, royal tombs, and extraordinary rock-carved architecture.

faqs.q: What is the cancellation policy for the 4-Day Jordan Tour?
faqs.a: You can generally cancel free of charge up to 30 days before the tour departure date. Cancellations made within the applicable cancellation period may be subject to fees according to the booking terms and cancellation policy. Travel insurance is recommended for additional flexibility and protection.

faqs.q: Can the 4-Day Jordan Tour be customized?
faqs.a: Yes, the tour can be customized according to your preferences. You can add extra nights, upgrade hotel categories, include destinations such as the Dead Sea, Wadi Rum, Jerash, or Madaba, or arrange local guides for a more in-depth experience. Contact Magnificent Travel for a personalized itinerary and quotation.
